feature_importances.description: Delivery verified with OTP or biometric/physical signature
Penalty for detected timeline or record contradictions
Ratio of required evidence items attached and verified
Customer explicitly confirmed delivery/terms in communication
Valid refund was completed prior to dispute filing
Buffer time remaining before dispute response deadline expires
Merchant historical chargeback defense baseline for dispute category
Risk exposure tier based on dispute transaction amount
Order was cancelled within merchant policy window
Customer lifetime relationship and repeat order loyalty

sample_size_warning: Evaluated on 50 synthetic RJ Kitchen disputes. Not intended to represent live banking chargeback outcomes without retraining on real production disputes.
